description:
Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Sisay's Ring.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Sisay's Ring.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
